gen-luckiest-guy-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Loud, cheerful, and poured from a single line width. Carrois Gothic SC sits underneath with open curve endings and a lowercase close to capital height, so Luckiest Guy gets to shout while the text stays friendly.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-chocolate-classical-: Luckiest Guy hits the page cheerful and loud, its ink laid down like a thread with no swelling anywhere. And Chocolate Classical Sans answers with a broad-nibbed stroke that never curls shut, which is where the pair gets its strongest pull.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-gafata: Brash, bright and drawn with no stroke modulation at all. And Gafata, a contemporary sans with wide-eyed lowercase e shapes, gives that shouting heading a steadier voice to hand off to.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-golos-text: Golos Text fills its line with a generous x-height and a widely parted s, all built from one stroke width. But Luckiest Guy, cheerful and loud above it, is what gives the pair its punch.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-hedvig-letters-sans: Hedvig Letters Sans reads approachable and contemporary, its small letters standing nearly level with the capitals and its c left wide open. Hedvig Letters Sans next to Luckiest Guy feels like quiet conversation beside a blueprint stencil that happens to be cheering.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-heebo: Heebo reads neutral and professional, with a generous central band of text and curves that stop short instead of closing in. Over many paragraphs it stays comfortable, never competing with Luckiest Guy.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-hind-guntur: Hind Guntur reads modern and steady, with wide gaps at the curve ends and lowercase forms stamped like metal type. Hind Guntur lets Luckiest Guy keep the cheerful noise, then quietly carries the rest of the page.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-hind-mysuru: Hind Mysuru stays contemporary and level-headed. Its lowercase presses close to ascender height with each a left slightly ajar, while Luckiest Guy does the loud, cheerful, poured-ink work up top.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-hind-vadodara: Luckiest Guy is cheerful and loud, with a mean line set high and ink that looks poured. And Hind Vadodara keeps a uniform stroke with spacious terminal gaps, so a body size a notch above usual would show off its open e and a.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-karla: Luckiest Guy brings cheerful volume, one poured line width from edge to edge. But Karla's gaping c opening and stocky, generous middle band give the pair its strongest quality: loud on top, friendly below.
